targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_packages FROM main.accounting a LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=a.type_train_id WHERE a.is_complete=false AND COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') ~ '^(${training_type:regex})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'

panels.title: Осталось тренировок
panels.description: Считаются только занятия, связанные через schedule.accounting_id.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(a.count_train-u.used,0)),0) AS remaining_sessions FROM main.accounting a LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=a.type_train_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS used FROM main.schedule s WHERE s.accounting_id=a.id) u ON true WHERE a.is_complete=false AND COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') ~ '^(${training_type:regex})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'

panels.title: Плановая стоимость остатка
panels.description: Не остаток денег на счёте, а цена неиспользованных занятий по открытым пакетам.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(a.count_train-u.used,0)*a.price_per_train),0) AS remaining_value FROM main.accounting a LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=a.type_train_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS used FROM main.schedule s WHERE s.accounting_id=a.id) u ON true WHERE a.is_complete=false AND COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') ~ '^(${training_type:regex})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'

SELECT 100.0*COALESCE(SUM(LEAST(u.used,a.count_train)),0)/NULLIF(SUM(a.count_train),0) AS utilization_pct FROM main.accounting a LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=a.type_train_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS used FROM main.schedule s WHERE s.accounting_id=a.id) u ON true WHERE a.is_complete=false AND COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') ~ '^(${training_type:regex})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'

panels.title: Продажи пакетов
panels.description: Поступления при создании пакета, а не выручка занятий.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',a.created_at) AS time,COUNT(*) AS packages_sold,COALESCE(SUM(a.summ),0) AS cash_in,ROUND(AVG(a.summ),0) AS average_package_amount
FROM main.accounting a LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=a.type_train_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.created_at) AND COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') ~ '^(${training_type:regex})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.id AS package_id,CONCAT_WS(' ',c.name,c.surname) AS client,COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') AS training_type,a.created_at::date AS sold_at,CURRENT_DATE-a.created_at::date AS package_age_days,a.count_train AS purchased_sessions,u.used AS used_sessions,GREATEST(a.count_train-u.used,0) AS remaining_sessions,ROUND(100.0*LEAST(u.used,a.count_train)/NULLIF(a.count_train,0),1) AS usage_pct,a.price_per_train,GREATEST(a.count_train-u.used,0)*a.price_per_train AS remaining_value
FROM main.accounting a JOIN main.client c ON c.id=a.client_id LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=a.type_train_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS used FROM main.schedule s WHERE s.accounting_id=a.id) u ON true
WHERE a.is_complete=false AND COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') ~ '^(${training_type:regex})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'
ORDER BY remaining_sessions,package_age_days DESC

SELECT a.id AS package_id,CONCAT_WS(' ',c.name,c.surname) AS client,COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') AS training_type,a.created_at::date AS sold_at,CURRENT_DATE-a.created_at::date AS package_age_days,GREATEST(a.count_train-u.used,0) AS remaining_sessions
FROM main.accounting a JOIN main.client c ON c.id=a.client_id LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=a.type_train_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS used FROM main.schedule s WHERE s.accounting_id=a.id) u ON true
WHERE a.is_complete=false AND a.created_at<CURRENT_DATE-(${stale_days}::int) AND COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') ~ '^(${training_type:regex})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'
ORDER BY package_age_days DESC

SELECT a.id AS package_id,CONCAT_WS(' ',c.name,c.surname) AS client,COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') AS training_type,GREATEST(a.count_train-u.used,0) AS remaining_sessions,a.created_at::date AS sold_at
FROM main.accounting a JOIN main.client c ON c.id=a.client_id LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=a.type_train_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS used FROM main.schedule s WHERE s.accounting_id=a.id) u ON true
WHERE a.is_complete=false AND GREATEST(a.count_train-u.used,0) BETWEEN 1 AND ${low_balance_sessions} AND COALESCE(t.type_train,'Не задан') ~ '^(${training_type:regex})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'
ORDER BY remaining_sessions,sold_at
